# Brandon Allan Fluegel — Human Factors Portfolio

> Brandon Allan Fluegel, Ph.D. is a Senior Human Factors Design Engineer at Intuitive Surgical. This site documents his human factors research, engineering projects, and Human-AI Trust framework.

## Profile
- **Current role:** Senior Human Factors Design Engineer at Intuitive Surgical.
- **Education:** Ph.D. in Human Factors Psychology, Old Dominion University.
- **Prior project experience:** Amazon Devices Design Group, NASA Lunar Gateway, and Mercedes-Benz.
- **Areas of experience:** Human factors engineering, surgical and medical robotics, human-machine interaction, simulated-use validation, psychophysics, cognitive workload, and Human-AI interaction.
